high_level_description: This image is the cover of an issue of Empire magazine, dated September 2024. The cover features two prominent figures: Joaquin Phoenix as the Joker and Lady Gaga as Harley Quinn from the movie "Joker." Both characters are dressed in their iconic costumes and makeup. The background is a gradient of dark teal to black, creating a dramatic and intense atmosphere. The title "EMPIRE" is prominently displayed in large red letters at the top of the cover. Below the title, there are several headlines and articles listed on the left side: "GLADIATOR II UNLEASH THE RHINOS!"
